publicationScope: Every listed entry has public-ready standing and an exact source package in this projection.

skills.name: architecture-convergence-vantages
skills.title: Architecture convergence vantages
skills.description: Coordinates bounded technical vantages around a consequential implementation choice and synthesizes one guarantee map, fitting architecture, and receiving route. Applies when several plausible changes affect concurrency, recovery, portability, evidence, or publication differently.

skills.name: bounded-representation-admission
skills.title: Bounded representation admission
skills.description: Places representation budgets and owned-value admission before costly parsing, copying, traversal, and output expansion. Applies when external files or caller-owned values can exceed the receiving computation or produce a report its own receiver rejects.

skills.name: contextual-jargon-scan
skills.title: Contextual jargon scan
skills.description: Classifies potentially specialist or inside wording within a bounded corpus and revises replaceable shorthand into ordinary language. Applies when Registry orientation, artifact documentation, public projection copy, or cross-team prose may rely on context its reader does not share.

skills.name: controlled-context-comparison
skills.title: Controlled context comparison
skills.description: Constructs paired observations that isolate a declared change while preserving source evidence, allowed dependencies, and complete outcome accounting. Applies when context, policy, presentation, or model-input differences may change a downstream result.

skills.name: interruption-safe-resource-ownership
skills.title: Interruption-safe resource ownership
skills.description: Maps acquisition, transfer, release attempts, and failure precedence across an owned operation. Applies when partial construction, interruption, nested cleanup, or publication can leave a resource or recovery state ambiguous.

skills.name: longitudinal-observation-visualization
skills.title: Longitudinal observation visualization
skills.description: Preserves observation identity, timing, support, and comparison meaning in longitudinal views. Applies to sparse or irregular measurements, repeated units, event alignment, annual panels, and time-ordered paths through multiple measures.

skills.name: omics-coordinate-and-measurement-views
skills.title: Omics coordinate and measurement views
skills.description: Prepares omics matrices and genomic tracks whose feature/sample identity, reference coordinates, assay quantities, replicate support, and uncertainty remain recoverable. Applies when omics figures join metadata, combine genomic tracks, compare samples or cell groups, or display assay effects.

skills.name: parity-bound-workload-measurement
skills.title: Parity-bound workload measurement
skills.description: Compares complete behavior cost under a declared workload after semantic and recovery parity are established. Applies when an optimization may move computation, allocation, transport, query, or review work across boundaries.

skills.name: probe-bearing-exemplar-formation
skills.title: Probe-bearing exemplar formation
skills.description: Forms a first reviewable registry coordinate from a source-grounded technical question, focused evidence, and a named receiving use. Applies when a public-safe code sample, Practitioner Probe, or domain exemplar is ready for its first registry version.

skills.name: repository-collaboration-cycle
skills.title: Repository collaboration cycle
skills.description: Carries an authorized repository task from current-truth reconstruction through source-owned execution, fitting evidence, one reviewable return, and exact re-entry. Applies when a cold or resumed collaborator should complete a full repository work cycle using the receiving repository's accepted implementation.

skills.name: scientific-figure-composition
skills.title: Scientific figure composition
skills.description: Composes scientifically faithful figures with deliberate panel geometry, visual hierarchy, semantic color, annotation, and final-size delivery. Applies when a correct plot needs a coherent paper, poster, slide, report, or web presentation.

skills.name: scientific-scale-and-transform-fidelity
skills.title: Scientific scale and transform fidelity
skills.description: Selects and verifies scientific numeric display transformations while preserving domain, parameters, units, values, and uncertainty. Applies when wide dynamic range, signed values, zeros, normalization, transformed axes or colors, and interval geometry can change a reading.

skills.name: secret-boundary-inspection
skills.title: Secret-boundary inspection
skills.description: Produces a canary-proven, scope-explicit secret-material observation through a receiving repository's accepted scanner. Applies before source, exact-index, local-history, artifact, or repository handoffs where credential-shaped material could travel.

skills.name: spatial-support-and-change-visualization
skills.title: Spatial support and change visualization
skills.description: Preserves spatial support, geography identity, denominators, and temporal comparability when selecting maps and coordinated views. Applies to year panels, sparse trajectories, regional change, and space-time comparisons whose geometry can alter interpretation.

skills.name: transaction-boundary-evidence-mapping
skills.title: Transaction boundary evidence mapping
skills.description: Maps a logical operation's meaning, accepted-state dependency, aligned effects, publication point, retry outcomes, and evidence owners. Applies when several state changes must become visible together or retry correctness depends on whether publication occurred.

skills.name: typed-error-recovery-contracts
skills.title: Typed error and recovery contracts
skills.description: Designs stable error types, bounded diagnostics, and explicit recovery at an owned operation boundary. Applies when generic exceptions obscure admission, stale state, execution failure, interruption, or the disposition of previously accepted work.

skills.name: versioned-exemplar-successor
skills.title: Versioned exemplar successor
skills.description: Carries a material technical strengthening from an accepted registry artifact into a new runnable version and exact derived teaching surfaces. Applies when stronger implementation, comments, tests, or evidence would exceed an immutable version's demonstrated behavior.

skills.name: visualization-question-routing
skills.title: Visualization question routing
skills.description: Translates a reader question and data structure into explicit variable roles and one defensible visual comparison. Applies when several forms fit, time or location can play different roles, or a chart arrives before its evidence-reading job.
